# NovoTech Machine Tools Inc.

> Metalworking and metal fabrication machinery supplier in Mississauga, ON, Canada. Sells, installs and supports press brakes, laser cutters, shears, ironworkers, plate rollers, angle rolls, bandsaws, cold saws, rebar benders and cutters, pipe benders, hydraulic presses, punching machines, bevelers, deburring and finishing machines, corner grinders and corner welders, notchers, aluminum and PVC window and door machinery and press brake tooling. Machines are supplied with CSA-approved electrical panels and supported with spare parts and technical support from Canada.

Contact: +1 647 526 5510 · info (at) NovoTechMachineTools.com · 1365 Mid-Way Blvd, Unit 26, Mississauga, ON L5T 2J5, Canada.
NovoTech is appointing independent sales agents and dealers in cities and provinces across Canada; enquiries through the quote form on any product page or by phone.
Social: YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@NovoTechMachineTools · LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/novotech-machine-tools-inc/ · Facebook https://www.facebook.com/novotechmachinetoolscanada · Instagram https://www.instagram.com/novotech_machinetools/
Brands represented include GMS GöçMakSan (rebar machinery), Dener (press brakes, shears, lasers), Senfeng (fiber lasers, laser welders), ISITAN, Bekamak, Pilous, Gecam and Eurofintec, Plastmak, CKEMSA, LFSS, Cevisa and EUROSTAMP tooling.

## Buying guides

Short buying guides written by NovoTech's technicians; each sits at the bottom of its product page, before the FAQ.

- [Band saw buying guide](https://novotechmachinetools.com/band-saw#buying-guide): pivot or double-column, manual to automatic, blades, speeds and feeds, troubleshooting.
- [Plate roller buying guide](https://novotechmachinetools.com/plate-rollers#buying-guide): 3-roll or 4-roll, initial or double pinch, capacity ratings, cones, crowning, automation.
- [Ironworker buying guide](https://novotechmachinetools.com/ironworker-machines#buying-guide): sizing by punching tonnage, stations, shears, safety, build quality.
- [Press brake tooling guide](https://novotechmachinetools.com/press-brake-tooling-punch-and-die#tooling-guide): clamping styles, V opening, tonnage chart, sectioned tools.
- [Press brake buying guide and tonnage calculator](https://novotechmachinetools.com/press-brake#buying-guide): air bending and the V-die, the EUROSTAMP tonnage formula F = S² × 2 × R ÷ (1.4 × V) t/m (R = 47 kg/mm² mild steel, 70 stainless, 25 aluminum; 575 × t² ÷ V US tons per foot in inches), a table of force per metre and per foot and the press brake to choose for a 10 ft bend from 20 ga to 1″ with the standard V, a calculator (thickness, length, material, V, reserve → V opening, minimum flange, inside radius, force and recommended tonnage in metric and US tons), hydraulic, hybrid and electric drives, back gauge axes, crowning, tooling and the Ontario pre-start review.
- [Panel bender buying guide](https://novotechmachinetools.com/panel-bender#buying-guide): How a panel bender folds four sides in one set-up, when it beats a press brake, how capacity is rated, and what automatic tool change and robot loading add.
- [V-grooving machine buying guide](https://novotechmachinetools.com/v-grooving-machine#buying-guide): Sharp corners in stainless and aluminum panels: why groove, horizontal or vertical machines, groove depth and angle, and how grooved panels are bent.
- [Sheet metal brake buying guide](https://novotechmachinetools.com/folder-sheet-metal-brake#buying-guide): Hand, box and pan, magnetic and hydraulic brakes compared, how capacity is rated in gauges of steel, stainless and aluminum, and folder or press brake.
- [Horizontal press brake buying guide](https://novotechmachinetools.com/horizontal-press-brake#buying-guide): Bending, punching, shearing and straightening bar on one machine: sizing by flat bar and holes, the tools to order, and the NC recipes and back gauge.
- [Angle roll buying guide](https://novotechmachinetools.com/angle-rolls#buying-guide): How three rolls bend sections into rings, why the section matters more than its size, twist and roll sets, and NC and spiral bending.
- [Tube and pipe bender buying guide](https://novotechmachinetools.com/pipe-benders#buying-guide): Tube or pipe, CLR, D of bend and wall factor, which bending method, when you need a mandrel, NC or CNC, and the tooling to order.
